method_name_or_family: Three-state hidden Markov model with celerite baseline
scientific_rationale: The HMM/celerite method targets upstream flare detection rather than the frozen AFINO QPP classification target. Its known-truth injection-recovery architecture has already informed the prospective F3B truth, selection-function and held-out design; a second upstream event detector would change the scientific question rather than provide a like-for-like classifier comparator.
effect_on_f3b_design: Methodological analogue for known-truth injection-recovery and selection-function framing; no external classifier output enters DEVELOPMENT or HELDOUT metrics.

method_name_or_family: Fully convolutional neural network (FCN) QPP classifier
scientific_rationale: This is the strongest direct external QPP-classifier candidate, but BAII/F3A.1 record no project-usable implementation. A faithful benchmark would require training/retraining and new-label decisions plus handling the exponentially decaying signal-family mismatch. Introducing that training design now would add an unfrozen scientific model family beyond the prospectively restricted F3B rule development policy.
effect_on_f3b_design: Retained as direct classifier context and a boundary on future work; not used to select, tune or validate the F3B rule.

scientific_rationale: Wavelet denoising plus injection-recovery is a useful selection-function analogue, but the CHEOPS/low-energy flare context and preprocessing target are not a like-for-like comparator to the frozen TESS AFINO QPP classifier. Its validation principle is represented prospectively without importing a new denoising pipeline.
effect_on_f3b_design: Supports methodological discussion of injection-recovery and selection functions; no wavelet-denoised series are generated.

scientific_rationale: ardor is an upstream TESS flare-detection pipeline. Rebuilding the parent event universe would conflate event detection with QPP classification. Its injection tests and completeness/false-selection logic inform the design conceptually but do not constitute a fair AFINO classifier comparator.
effect_on_f3b_design: Used only as literature support for prospective injection-recovery/selection handling; no change to the synthetic QPP classifier population.

method_name_or_family: Logistic regression + FRED template flare detection
scientific_rationale: Logistic/FRED flare detection is a ground-based upstream-event method with cadence and noise assumptions different from the frozen TESS QPP problem. Its injection-recovery logic is methodologically relevant, while implementation as a held-out QPP comparator is not scientifically like-for-like.
effect_on_f3b_design: Methodological validation analogue only; no logistic/FRED detector is executed.

scientific_rationale: flarenet is a TESS 20-s CNN flare detector and BAII/F3A.1 record training/new-label requirements but no project-usable frozen implementation. A faithful reproduction would require a new training protocol and would still test upstream flare detection rather than QPP classification. It is therefore not introduced into the frozen F3B validation experiment.
effect_on_f3b_design: Its synthetic-injection, threshold and gap/quality considerations inform design context; no CNN training or inference is performed.
